messages:
Nora (CS): Quick sync: Polaris dedicated pool onboarding tomorrow 10:30 PT. Need final signoffs on quota, autoscale, and the customer-facing runbook. Also flagging a renewal conversation scheduled for 28 days post-go-live.
Amit - Infra: I've double-checked the reserved quota mapping to org:polaris-prod. Billing shows 275k tokens/min reserved. Can we confirm the customer's expected sustained vs burst split?
Hannah (AE): Customer expects ~220k sustained and optional 480k burst for the first hour after each deploy. They're keen we have a soft fallback before any hard rejects.
Talia (SRE): Proposed fallback ordering: 1) reduce max_concurrency for non-stream calls, 2) steer to quantized variant, 3) apply token-level rate limit. Will implement alert hooks for each stage.
Marco (QA): I'll run two load tests: (A) shadow-surge at 07:00 PT (internal only) and (B) joint run with customer at 09:45 PT. I'll post CSVs and p50/p95/p99 latencies + 5xx counts.
Nora (CS): Include SDK streaming chunk times in QA capture. They reported occasional jitter in staging last week.
Amit - Infra: Autoscale snippet I'm about to push:
```yaml
pool: polaris-prod
autoscale:
  min_gpus: 8
  target_tokens_per_gpu_per_min: 14000
  max_gpus: 36
  scale_window: 90s
  burst_settings:
    enabled: true
    duration_seconds: 3600
    multiplier: 2.0
  fallback_model: redwood-compact-v1
  maintenance_blackout: 04:00-12:00 PT
```
Talia (SRE): Add `in_flight_drain_secs: 20` and a pager rule: sev1 if p95 > 1000ms for 3m or 5xx rate > 1.5% for 2m. Also schedule a canary rollback plan in case of sustained errors.
ops-bot: Reminder: cluster-pol-1 blackout window set for 04:00-12:00 PT.
Marco (QA): Shadow-surge 07:00 results: sustained 230k tokens/min for 15m, p95=460ms, 5xx=0.6%. KV priming reduced tail latency by ~18%. Uploading full report.
Hannah (AE): I'll run the customer smoke at 09:45 PT and capture their subjective latency. Also noting renewal touch: customer asked for a cost/runbook review at day 14. Logging as action item.
Nora (CS): Final checklist: billing quota confirmed (Hannah), autoscale PR merged (Amit), SRE alert rules applied (Talia), QA reports posted (Marco), customer smoke run & feedback (Hannah). Post final go/no-go here after the 09:45 run. :white_check_mark:
